description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of correct and incorrect responses across different categories, labeled from 0 to 4 on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis is labeled "γ/B" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.6 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Each category is represented by a pair of bars, with the blue dotted bar indicating "Incorrect" responses and the red striped bar representing "Correct" responses, as shown in the legend. The height of the "Incorrect" bars decreases from approximately 0.4 at category 0 to around 0.28 at category 4, while the "Correct" bars decrease from about 0.72 at category 0 to roughly 0.45 at category 4. The bars are grouped by category, with the "Incorrect" bar positioned to the left of the "Correct" bar in each group. The chart does not display any specific sorting order beyond the categorical labeling, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color and pattern coding indicated in the legend.
